title: Vision Plans Pediatric Exam Fee Ratio
content:
On the Vision Plans, a pediatric fee ratio applies to the scheduled exam fee of a routine eye exam for a patient under 19 (the child age limit) on the date of service. Age is counted in whole years from the enrollee's date of birth to the date of service.

| Patient's age on the date of service | Participating independent practice | Participating retail-chain location | Out of network |
|---|---|---|---|
| Under 19 | 1.15 | 1.10 | 1 |
| 19 or over | 1 | 1 | 1 |

**Boundary (hypothetical dates).** A patient born on 3 September turns 19 on 3 September. An exam on 2 September of that year is for an 18-year-old, so the ratio is 1.15 at an independent practice and 1.10 at a retail-chain location. An exam on 3 September is for a 19-year-old, and the ratio is 1.

**Basis Q&A**
- *Does the pediatric ratio apply to an out-of-network exam?* No. Every out-of-network visit keeps a ratio of 1.
- *Which date decides the age?* The date of service of the visit.
